title: The Bottle with My Name
can_do: 说明物品属于谁，并补充一个能辨认它的特征。
trigger: Rabbit Teacher finds a bottle, but another bottle has the same yellow-star design.
core_response: It's mine. It has a yellow star.
stretch_response: Mine has my name under the yellow star.
repair_response: That one is not mine. Mine has my name.
setting: A light classroom setting after art time.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: This water bottle was left by the art table. Whose is it?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: It's mine. It has a yellow star.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: I see two bottles with yellow stars.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mine has my name under the star.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Here is the one with your name.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, that is mine. I will put it in my bag.

replay_cards.title: Whose coat?
replay_cards.change: Two coats are the same color
replay_cards.challenge: Say the coat is yours, name the animal patch, confirm it, and put it on

replay_cards.title: Whose drawing?
replay_cards.challenge: Say which is yours using the name or subject on it, turn it over, and take it

parent_support: Use a feature that really distinguishes the item; a name label is especially useful.
Do not treat possession as proven until the identifying detail matches.
